newsitem.title: GERMANY: German steel output set to rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: German steel output set to rise in 1997.

text.p: Germany's iron and steel institute VDEh and industry group Wirtschaftvereinigung Stahl said on Thursday German steel production was forecast to rise strongly in 1997.
The groups said they expected German steel output to fall by three percent this year, but the industry was past crisis point.
Iron and steel finishing in 1997 would reach about 41 million tonnes, they said.
The production of new types of steel and a renaissance in construction would boost steel processing, but energy and labour costs continued to cause problems in the sector.
